title: A project's plan: a DAG of tickets with blocking edges, laid out by milestone, from one tracker or the union of every declared one

states.description: The tracker's states in its order, or every declared tracker's in a union plan

type.description: The kind of state, in the order work moves through them

name.description: The tracker's own name for the state

tracker.description: The scope's name, in a union plan's states

name.description: The scope's name among the repository's trackers; the kind when it gives none

org.description: The org the tracker's account belongs to: a GitHub owner; empty where the credential implies it

key.description: The key of what owns the tickets within the org: a Linear team's key, a GitHub repository's name, a plan file's path

project.description: The project inside the key, or empty

target.description: The end date, ISO 8601, or null

tracker.description: The scope's name, in a union plan

id.description: The tracker's own id, for writes

key.description: The name the tracker gives the ticket, and the name edges use: SHOP-44, org/repo#12

milestone.description: The id of the milestone it sits under

lane.description: The column the ticket stacks in: its initiative, else its project, as the tracker names it; null when the tracker gives none

stub.description: True for a ticket outside the scope that an edge reaches

tracker.description: The scope's name; null for a stub no declared tracker holds

blocker.description: The key of the ticket that blocks

blocked.description: The key of the ticket that is blocked
